name: naijatape.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But form elements must have labels.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id.
summary: www.naijatape.com scores 72 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Form elements must have labels
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /leak-videos/, /teen/, for example #focus_retriever. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 84 elements on /, /leak-videos/, /teen/, for example #post-50882 > .wp-post-image-link[rel="bookmark"] and #post-50880 > .wp-post-image-link[rel="bookmark"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /, /leak-videos/, /teen/, for example .button-text. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.
